gaps: The Secretary of State's own results files

Towns and wards report to the Secretary of State, whose results workbooks are the official record of every contest; the Secretary's site refuses programs (it answers with an Akamai 'Access Denied'), so none was read from it. John can save them from the results page in his own browser.

The Clerk of the House's figures (stored) and the FEC's (the control) differ: Joseph R. Biden: Clerk 424,921, FEC 424,937; Donald J. Trump: Clerk 365,654, FEC 365,660; Jo Jorgensen: Clerk 13,235, FEC 13,236. Neither is the State's own record, whose 2020 workbooks could not be read.
Governor, Executive Council, State Senate, State Representatives, county offices, and the towns and wards of the federal contests
